summary: User experienced API downtime due to expired token from failed auto-rotation script. Agent restored service via emergency token, offered 20% credit after negotiation, and agreed to assist with script fix later.

evaluation.reasoning: Agent acknowledged urgency and frustration immediately, apologized sincerely, and focused on resolution without defensiveness. Calmed user effectively despite initial hostility.
Agent correctly identified expired token as root cause and linked it to auto-rotation failure. Could have more clearly explained why auto-rotation failed or how to prevent recurrence.
Agent prioritized immediate restoration by offering a temporary token without debating fault. Service was restored within 60 seconds as promised.
Agent held firm on policy (no 50% refund for client-side issue) but offered escalating options and increased credit from 15% to 20% to close the ticket amicably.
Technical cause was explained simply (token expired → 503). Next steps (emergency token, email, timing) were clear and actionable. Follow-up on script fix was promised.

strengths: Exceptional de-escalation and rapid service restoration
improvements: Proactively explain how to prevent auto-rotation failure in future
Offer to schedule follow-up for script fix immediately rather than vaguely
